property_summary: For any deposit amount, a re-entrant caller of withdrawAll cannot complete its withdrawal (the re-entrant call hits the lock, fails, and the reference's require(callResult) reverts the outer call); the mutant swallows the failed re-entrant call and completes anyway.
change_summary: Remove the require(callResult) check so failed external calls no longer revert and the lock/credit updates proceed anyway.
